messages:
Ibrahim: Postmortem follow-up: this is less about one surge and more about a recurring pattern. Noting owners + short mitigations. Root cause thread: long tail batch job bursts + autoscaler cadence + quota crunch.
Zoe: Agreed. Can we add a proactive mitigation plan (not just reactive quotas)?
Ibrahim: Proposed short plan:
A) Predictive scale: add simple windowed rate predictor to trigger pre-scale when queued-GPU rate exceeds X for 5m. Owner: Riley. ETA 72h prototype.
B) Scheduler: lower preemptThreshold and enforce batch pod priority class; add binpack tweak. Owner: Ibrahim. ETA 48h.
C) Quota: request +20% provisional for 36h during testing. Owner: Zoe. ETA: submit today.
D) Ops checklist: add a "pre-scale rollback" and cost-guard (daily cost cap alert) to runbook. Owner: Zoe. ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow.
Riley: I'll drop a simple lambda to watch queue metrics and call autoscaler API in staging. Will add unit tests.
Zoe: CAP ticket opened: CAP-9122. Asked for provisional window and cost delta. @ops-bot please create follow-up reminder.
ops-bot: Task created: CAP-9122 linked to INC-4302. Calendar: follow-up review 2025-07-21 09:30 PT.
Ibrahim: Acceptance: either CAP approved or predictive scaling reduces surge frequency by >=60% over 14 days. Weekly syncs for 2 weeks after close. Ping here for handoffs.
Zoe: Adding checklist to runbook PR and marking WIP.
Riley: Will post staging graphs and link PR once tests pass.
Ibrahim: Thanks — I'll update the incident tracker and tag backups if needed.
